name: scene_intent_extractor
description: Extracts a structured SceneIntent from a natural language scene description. Uses keyword extraction (deterministic) with optional LLM enhancement. NEVER returns free-form text — outputs validated SceneIntent JSON only.

import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.semantic.scene_intent_extractor import get_scene_intent_extractor


class Scene_Intent_Extractor(BaseNode):
    name = "scene_intent_extractor"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("prompt",          "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("extra_context",   "any")
        self.add_input("skip_enrichment", "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_output("intent_json",     "string")
        self.add_output("intent",          "any")
        self.add_output("ok",              "bool")
        self.add_output("confidence",      "float")
        self.add_output("errors",          "any")
        self.add_output("warnings",        "any")
        self.add_output("pipeline_stages", "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        prompt = inputs.get("prompt", "") or ""
        if not prompt.strip():
            self.log_error("scene_intent_extractor: 'prompt' is required.")
            return {
                "intent_json":     "{}",
                "intent":          None,
                "ok":              False,
                "confidence":      0.0,
                "errors":          ["'prompt' input is empty"],
                "warnings":        [],
                "pipeline_stages": [],
                "exec_out":        True,
            }

        extra_context   = inputs.get("extra_context") or {}
        skip_enrichment = bool(inputs.get("skip_enrichment", False))

        try:
            extractor = get_scene_intent_extractor()
            result    = await extractor.extract(
                prompt,
                extra_context=extra_context if extra_context else None,
                skip_enrichment=skip_enrichment,
            )

            intent_dict = result.intent.to_dict() if result.intent else {}
            intent_json = json.dumps(intent_dict, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

            return {
                "intent_json":     intent_json,
                "intent":          intent_dict,
                "ok":              result.ok,
                "confidence":      result.intent.confidence if result.intent else 0.0,
                "errors":          list(result.errors),
                "warnings":        list(result.warnings),
                "pipeline_stages": list(result.pipeline_stages),
                "exec_out":        True,
            }

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"scene_intent_extractor failed: {exc}")
            return {
                "intent_json":     "{}",
                "intent":          None,
                "ok":              False,
                "confidence":      0.0,
                "errors":          [str(exc)],
                "warnings":        [],
                "pipeline_stages": [],
                "exec_out":        True,
            }


def register_node():
    return Scene_Intent_Extractor
